data.text: Kickoff for Project Horizon and the separate Horizonline stream: keep the two names cleanly separated in memory. Horizon is the retail demand pilot; Horizonline is the healthcare support stream, and cross-project summaries must not mix customer, budget, vendor, or incident details.
